items.title: JPMorgan Hints At Another Delay For Tesla Optimus Release
items.summary: A new JPMorgan analyst report outlines a longer timeline for the eventual release of Tesla's Optimus robots. Tesla stock is down 1.7% on Thursday.

items.title: Ford Drops 4% as Bronco Pickup Rally Fades, Tesla Slips, General Motors Inches Higher: What’s Behind the Auto Stock Differential?
items.summary: Ford and General Motors share nearly identical business models and faced the same market session Thursday, yet one dropped sharply while the other climbed. The reason behind their split reveals something important about how quickly product-report rallies can unravel.
